name: Easel
title_zh: 跨平台发帖前先问你要发哪个平台的社媒管家
tagline_zh: 一个 Agent 管小红书、抖音、知乎、B站：先挖热点再写稿，发布后自动盯数据。不用在四个后台间来回切。
tagline_en: One agent finds trends, drafts posts, publishes to 4 Chinese platforms, then tracks what works. No more.
desc_en: An open-source AI agent for social media — discover trends, create content, publish everywhere, and learn what works across Xiaohongshu, Douyin, Zhihu, Bilibili, and more.🎨一个开源的 AI 社交媒体智能体——发现热点趋势、创作内容、一键发布至各大平台，并学习分析哪些内容真正有效，覆盖小红书、抖音、知乎、哔哩哔哩等平台。
why_zh: 它把「发现-创作-发布-复盘」闭环串成一条流水线，且每个环节都落在具体平台语境里。
why_en: It closes the loop from trend discovery to performance review, with each step tailored to the platform's own culture—not a.
limit_zh: 需要自备各平台账号及开放接口权限；内容审核与限流规则由平台方决定，Agent 无法绕过；只覆盖图文与短视频，直播。
limit_en: Requires your own accounts & API access per platform. Can't bypass platform review or rate limits. Covers posts & short videos only—no livestream or.

install.note: clone 下来，挑你要的那件复制进 ~/.claude/skills/。这是一个合集，没有「装它」这个动作。

title_en: A social media agent that publishes across XHS, Douyin.
